flawed_cycle_5.natural_language_hypothesis: Clicking an invalid unmapped button target will result in no state transition
flawed_cycle_5.logical_contradiction: The hypothesis stated that no state transition would occur (state_transition == false). However, expected_true was configured as {'state_transition': True}. When no transition occurred (reality was false), the experiment marked verified=False and refutation occurred, whereas the hypothesis predicting no change was actually SUPPORTED by reality.

contract_truth_rules: If observed matches supported_predicates -> hypothesis SUPPORTED (CONFIRMED)
If observed matches refuted_predicates -> hypothesis REFUTED
If observed matches neither or is unobservable -> INCONCLUSIVE

corrected_experiments.resolution: When pre_state_hash == post_state_hash (state_transition == False), the hypothesis predicting invariance is logically SUPPORTED.
